sections.title: Three variables that determine your LLM integration cost
sections.description: Understanding these drivers helps you budget realistically and scope the right project for your needs.

items.title: 1. LLM Model Selection
items.description: The choice of foundation model significantly affects both development and ongoing operation cost. GPT-4o (OpenAI) costs $5–$15/million tokens; Claude (Bedrock) costs $3–$6/million; self-hosted Llama requires GPU compute but offers data control and better unit economics at scale.
items.label: Model Choice

items.title: 2. Compliance Requirements
items.description: Compliance significantly increases LLM integration cost. HIPAA BAA: +$8K–$18K. SOC 2 Type II alignment: +$10K–$22K. FINRA recordkeeping: +$8K–$15K. CCPA opt-out infrastructure: +$6K–$14K.
items.label: Regulatory

items.title: 3. Enterprise Security Features
items.description: Enterprise security adds 25–40% to basic integration: SSO/SAML ($6K–$14K), RBAC ($5K–$12K), audit logging ($4K–$10K), penetration testing ($5K–$12K).
items.label: Security

sections.title: Ongoing LLM operation costs after launch
sections.description: After launch, LLM integrations have ongoing costs that aren't in the development budget. These are separate from the one-time development fee.

items.title: LLM API Costs
items.description: Variable by usage volume. At 1,000 conversations/day (~1,000 tokens avg): ~$150–$450/month for GPT-4o. At 10,000 conversations/day: ~$1,500–$4,500/month.
items.label: Monthly

items.title: Vector Database (RAG)
items.description: Pinecone or pgvector hosting costs $70–$500/month depending on index size and query volume.
items.label: Monthly

items.title: Cloud Infrastructure
items.description: Compute, storage, and networking costs for your LLM integration deployment — $500–$3,000/month depending on scale.
items.label: Monthly

items.title: Model Monitoring
items.description: LLM evaluation infrastructure, drift detection, and performance monitoring — $200–$1,000/month.
items.label: Monthly

sections.note: Total ongoing cost estimate: $800–$8,000+/month for a medium-scale production LLM integration.

sections.title: The questions serious buyers ask before committing to LLM integration
sections.description: No vague promises and no hidden discovery call required to understand the fundamentals.

items.answer: $20,000–$120,000 for development. Simple chatbots: $20,000–$35,000. Enterprise RAG with compliance: $70,000–$100,000.

items.objection: Is there ongoing cost after the LLM integration is built?
items.answer: Yes — LLM API costs ($150–$4,500+/month depending on volume), vector database, and infrastructure. Total ongoing: $800–$8,000+/month for medium scale.

items.objection: How long does LLM integration take?
items.answer: 6–20 weeks. Simple chatbot: 6–10 weeks. Enterprise RAG with compliance documentation: 14–20 weeks.

items.objection: Which LLM should I use — GPT-4o, Claude, or Llama?
items.answer: Depends on use case and data governance. Healthcare requiring HIPAA BAA → AWS Bedrock (Claude) or Azure OpenAI. Data sovereignty → self-hosted Llama 3. General enterprise → GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

items.objection: What's the difference between RAG and fine-tuning cost?
items.answer: RAG ($35,000–$100,000) adds document retrieval at inference time — best for knowledge management. Fine-tuning ($15,000–$60,000) trains the model on your style and domain — best for generation format and voice.

sections.title: LLM integration cost vs. LLM API run cost — a key distinction

blocks.heading: Development cost (one-time) vs. Run cost (ongoing)
paragraphs: **Development cost (one-time):** $20,000–$120,000 — what ClickMasters charges to build the integration, including architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment.
**Run cost (ongoing):** $800–$8,000+/month — what you pay to operate the integration in production (LLM API costs, vector database, cloud infrastructure, monitoring).
ClickMasters models your expected run cost during Discovery so you can budget for both development and ongoing operation before committing.

blocks.heading: How the ratio varies by use case
paragraphs: High-volume consumer chatbot: low development cost, high run cost (many API calls).
Enterprise RAG for small internal team: moderate development cost, low run cost.
Complex multi-agent automation: high development cost, variable run cost.

sections.title: How to reduce LLM integration cost without reducing value

blocks.heading: Use smaller models for simpler tasks
paragraphs: GPT-4o-mini or Claude Haiku for classification, routing, and simple extraction — reserving GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet for complex reasoning tasks. Routing intelligently between models can reduce inference cost by 70–90% vs. using the largest model for everything.

blocks.heading: Cache frequently asked questions
paragraphs: For RAG systems where users ask similar questions repeatedly, caching popular queries and their retrieved answers can reduce LLM API costs significantly.

blocks.heading: Reduce unnecessary token usage
paragraphs: System prompts are charged every API call — optimizing system prompt length reduces inference cost at scale without reducing quality.
